resolved_failures: A workstation restart initially omitted migration 43 and GET/run requests failed on the missing assessment table. The idle workstation was migrated; startup now rejects stale schema before serving requests or starting workers.

Final verification first used a nonexistent test selector and omitted the explicit browser target environment, producing no tests and one skip. Both commands were corrected; the accepted runs above contain no skips.

boundaries: Overlapping checks are not a full-repository test total.
Each trial is an explicit independent birth; learning never writes back to the source and no child is automatically registered as a parent.
Missing, failed, cancelled and unfinished trials remain in the declared denominator. Bounds describe that finite trial set, not a confidence interval or probability in future environments.
Only implemented endpoint metrics are selectable. Network activity does not establish intent, intelligence or consciousness.
All AI verification used a local mock. No external provider requests, real speech or notifications were sent.
No data/ scan or legacy migration; no Core or birth-rule change; no Docker rebuild or git push in this stage.
